problem: Create a distinctive, reference-quality portfolio grounded in Dharmil Virani's resume and local projects.
outcome: Visitors understand his specialism, inspect credible work, experience a small working demonstration, and contact him or download his resume.

requirements.need: Research standout portfolio UI, content organization, and skill demonstration
Accurate biography, experience, skills and curated case studies
Working project navigation, skill demonstration, contact and resume
Maintainable structured content and static delivery
requirements.test: Content validation, typecheck and production build

requirements.need: Keyboard access, contrast, reduced motion and useful no-JS content

experience.direction: Warm paper, oversized confident typography, cobalt ink, fine technical grid and purposeful system diagrams
experience.journey: Positioning -> selected work -> case study -> experience -> contact
experience.motion: Short hover/focus transitions and user-triggered demonstration; native scrolling
experience.fallback: Server-generated HTML, native links, static illustration, reduced-motion CSS

architecture.stack: Astro static pages, TypeScript, authored CSS, schema-validated Markdown case studies
architecture.content_management: Repository files; no external CMS account required
architecture.deployment: Portable static dist; public deployment excluded until requested

quality.accessibility_target: WCAG 2.2 AA intent; automated checks do not certify conformance

assumptions.text: Engineering hiring and collaboration are the primary outcomes
Resume dates and facts are authoritative as supplied; present employment is not independently reverified
No measured project performance numbers, adoption counts or testimonials will be invented

optional: External CMS if editorial needs grow
